guidance_for_write_dockerfile_agent: The Dockerfile fails during the build process with the error 'fatal: destination path '.' already exists and is not an empty directory.' at the step where it tries to clone the repository into the current working directory (RUN git clone https://github.com/agentscope-ai/agentscope.git . && git reset --hard a2bf80ec96e29cb760ac6d4018680d6af68c9416). This error happens because the working directory /testbed/ is not empty when the git clone command runs. To fix this issue, revise the Dockerfile to either remove or clean the /testbed directory before cloning, or change the git clone command to clone into an empty directory (e.g., clone into /testbed/agentscope and then set WORKDIR to that path). Alternatively, avoid cloning into '.' if the directory is not empty. This correction will allow the docker build step to complete successfully and enable further test execution steps.
